description:
Must Haves: 

- 4+ years of professional Django/Python development experience

- 3+ years of experience working with relational databases

- 2+ years of professional work experience with HTML

- 2+ years using a non-jQuery HTML5 framework

- Experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs

- Basic knowledge of CSS

- Basic knowledge of SQL

- Excellent analytical abilities

- Experience using healthy design and coding patterns to produce simple code for complex problems

- Experience using front end and back end debuggers


Even Better: 

- UNIX shell and network expertise

- Dev/Ops experience

- Experience working in an Agile environment 

- 5+ years of professional work experience as a rich internet application developer

- Experience with a variety of JavaScript libraries (Lodash, jQuery, moment, D3, Angular)

- Experience developing commercial software products

- git expertise

- Knowledge of multiple languages/alternative frameworks and ability to learn new technologies 

- Ability to communicate with business and technical teams both verbally and written

- Experience deploying apps to AWS

- Excellent understanding of Django's ORM 



 Skill : Python, Django, AWS, DevOps, HTML, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, UI, AJAX, REST


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
